card.title: MOSQUITO F Mk II
card.text: At the end of turn, Convert into MOSQUITO B Mk IV.
card.flavorText: The de Havilland Mosquito F Mk II was a fighter variant of the iconic British multirole aircraft, introduced in 1941. It  was designed as a night fighter, featured an AI (Air Interception) Mk IV radar operated by a second crewmember and was armed with four 20mm Hispano cannons in the nose and four .303-inch Browning machine guns in the fuselage. The F Mk II’s speed (over 612 km/h) and agility made it effective against German bombers like the Heinkel He 111 and Junkers Ju 88. Early models were modified to carry external fuel tanks for extended range during so-called "Intruder" missions, aimed at disrupting enemy airfields and night operations. The F Mk IIs also defended British airspace during the Baedeker Blitz, a series of bombing raids by the Luftwaffe on the UK in 1942, and conducted nighttime raids over occupied France. Some were later adapted for training or radar calibration. This variant’s success laid groundwork for improved Mosquito night fighters such as the NF Mk XII, which integrated more advanced radar systems.
